context.purpose: Archive a bounded PCM16 WAV recording as native lossless FLAC, or decode a native FLAC recording into the canonical PCM16 WAV that speech preparation (SoX conform, transcription) accepts, with every PCM byte proven by a fresh native decode. Optionally the archive carries up to three author-declared labels (title, artist, description) as native Vorbis comments so a recording keeps its name with its audio. Unsuitable for lossy audio, 24-bit or multichannel material, editing, tagging or proving a recording is authentic.
context.assumptions: Captured local PCM16 mono or stereo audio at 8000-192000 Hz, at most 600 seconds and a 32 MiB canonical WAV. A configured FLAC 1.5 flac executable; the host never decodes FLAC frames itself and only checks STREAMINFO, metadata framing and the first frame header.
context.constraints: Native FLAC only (no Ogg, no ID3 prefix); STREAMINFO exactly once and first, nonzero sample count and nonzero MD5. Fixed encoder -8 with verification, no padding and no seek table; no authored flags. Without authored labels the Vorbis comment is empty. Labels are optional, encodeLossless only, closed to title/artist/description, nonempty visible plain UTF-8 stored exactly as authored. Pictures, other tags, seek tables, padding and WAV LIST/JUNK chunks are never carried, and decodePCM16 drops tags. FLAC MD5 agreement is file consistency, not authenticity.
context.inspection: Inspect the audio file and flac-summary.json (geometry, durations, PCM bytes, SHA-256, MD5, per-channel peaks, STREAMINFO, metadata blocks, dropped chunks and, for a labelled archive, the metadata record read back from the published VORBIS_COMMENT). verify needs the trusted flac (SCHEMAXIS_FLAC or a stored flac location; --flac belongs to run): it re-decodes the actual FLAC bytes in a private directory and compares every PCM byte; there is no host FLAC decoder.
context.recovery: INVALID_FLAC_SOURCE: absolute regular local .wav (encode) or .flac (decode). INVALID_FLAC_METADATA: write nonempty visible plain-text title, artist or description labels within 200/200/1000 code points and 512/512/3000 UTF-8 bytes (no control, bidirectional, surrogate, private-use or invisible characters); UNKNOWN_ARGUMENT: labels are not accepted by decodePCM16 and no other metadata field exists. INVALID_FLAC_WAV: corrupt or outside the PCM16 mono/stereo subset. INVALID_FLAC_STREAM: malformed FLAC framing or STREAMINFO; re-export. UNSUPPORTED_FLAC_FORMAT: Ogg, ID3-prefixed, non-16-bit, more than two channels, rate outside 8000-192000 Hz, unknown length or zero MD5; convert first. FLAC_BUDGET: shorten below 600 s or 32 MiB. FLAC_STREAM_REJECTED: damaged frames or a sample count/MD5 mismatch found by the native decode. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure flac (--flac, SCHEMAXIS_FLAC or a stored location). UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME: use FLAC 1.5. VERIFICATION_FAILED: the published bytes, retained evidence or its JSON types changed; rerun into a fresh directory.

workflow.scope: A verified file artifact (a SoX output or a FLAC/WAV publication) can be the source; the audio file and summary publish through the normal scheduler with provenance. A decodePCM16 output feeds SoX conform.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure expressions and finite studies resolve before the native recipe.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers the version probe, encode, run readback decode and the fresh verification decode. Each child CPU 180 s, address space 2 GiB, output size capped to the expected PCM plus 1 MiB; standalone verify has a 300 s budget.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned process-group cancellation; serial children and a final cancellation/deadline check before publication.
lifecycle.logs: Authored/effective plan, captured input and byte binding (with the authored labels when present), raw PCM bridge, run readback, exact launchers, input hashes, stage stdout/stderr/submissions and an independently computed summary.
lifecycle.verification: Host STREAMINFO, metadata framing and first-frame checks, plus a fresh trusted flac decode of a private copy of the actual FLAC bytes compared byte for byte (encode: with the captured WAV PCM; decode: with the published WAV), the STREAMINFO MD5 and sample count recomputed by the host. Not an independent decoder: flac is the oracle. For a labelled archive the host also parses the actual published VORBIS_COMMENT (little-endian lengths, vendor, count, entries) and requires exactly the authored fixed-field entries in fixed order.

losses: LIST and JUNK chunks are dropped (their text is not used as labels); no other chunk is accepted.
data.scope: Captured regular local WAV within 600 seconds and 32 MiB.

traits.container: native FLAC, STREAMINFO plus a Vorbis comment: empty, or exactly the authored title/artist/description labels

losses: Lossless for samples; only authored title, artist and description labels are carried (as declared text, not provenance); no pictures or cue points; the file may be larger than the WAV for noise-like audio.
data.scope: One audio.flac then a text summary.

losses: Tags (including authored labels from an earlier archive), pictures, seek tables, padding, application blocks and cue sheets are dropped and listed.
data.scope: Captured regular local native FLAC with a known sample count and MD5, within 600 seconds.

losses: The WAV carries no metadata; its size is at most 32 MiB so SoX conform accepts it.
data.scope: One audio.wav then a text summary.

inspection.scope: JSON geometry, byte counts, hashes, peaks, STREAMINFO, metadata and dropped chunks.
inspection.limits: Host-authored summary recomputed during verification; no playback and no independent FLAC decoder.

authoring.reuse: Change the absolute source. Retain source bytes for provenance; same-path byte changes invalidate scheduler reuse.

workflow.scope: A verified file artifact (SoX output or FLAC/WAV publication) can be the source; decodePCM16 output feeds SoX conform through the normal scheduler.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure expressions and finite studies resolve before the native recipe.

reusable-inputs.scope: The absolute source path and captured byte digest participate in reuse identity.

source-authoring.scope: Editable JSON source with common undo and validation.

property-authoring.scope: Common pointer forms expose the source field and, for encodeLossless, the optional closed metadata object (title, artist, description); the contract has no other authored properties.

conversion.scope: Two named operations: encodeLossless (WAV to FLAC) and decodePCM16 (FLAC to canonical PCM16 WAV) with explicit losses and native readback acceptance. No other format or lossy conversion.

native-inspection.scope: No interactive native inspection; the audio file and its JSON summary are ordinary publications.

mpi.scope: The recipe is serial; each native process is a single thread.

time-batches.scope: No temporal batching; common finite studies remain available.

live-editing.scope: No persistent native session; edit JSON then create a new bounded run.

native-save.scope: FLAC and WAV publications are supported; there is no application session or project save.

cases.scope: Hand-built 48 kHz stereo WAV, 4099 frames (odd, spanning two FLAC blocks) with pinned asymmetric extrema: left -32768..32767, right -32768..20000. Counts and peaks are literal expectations from the fixture recipe, independent of the adaptor. The decision is the fresh native flac decode compared byte for byte with the captured PCM.

Hand-built 8 kHz mono WAV, 1001 frames with a LIST chunk (dropped and listed) and extrema -32768 and 32767 plus 0, 1 and -1 at the start. Literal expectations; fresh native decode compared byte for byte.

The 8 kHz mono LIST-bearing fixture archived with all three ASCII labels, one value containing "=". The published VORBIS_COMMENT must hold exactly TITLE, ARTIST and DESCRIPTION in that order (hand-counted block size 152 bytes: 32-byte libFLAC vendor string plus three length-prefixed entries); the fresh native decode must still equal the captured PCM byte for byte.

checks.expected: Field note A=B; recorded before the repair

cases.scope: The 16 kHz stereo fixture archived with non-ASCII labels (accents, an en dash, Japanese, an arrow and a check mark). Values are preserved as exact UTF-8 bytes (36, 12 and 35 bytes for 22, 9 and 28 code points; block size 160) without normalisation, and the PCM identity is unchanged.

checks.expected: Café du Müller – 日本語メモ

cases.scope: Native FLAC of a hand-built 16 kHz stereo recording of 2049 frames with literal extrema left -32768..32766 and right -32767..32767. The decoded WAV payload must reproduce the STREAMINFO MD5 and sample count and equal the fresh native decode.
The same 16 kHz stereo audio in a FLAC that also carries a seek table, Vorbis comments and padding: the metadata is dropped and listed, and the decoded PCM is identical to the untagged case.

completion.scope: New adaptor 2026-10-25: schemaxis.flac/1 encodeLossless and decodePCM16 routes, independent PCM16 WAV reader and writer, STREAMINFO/metadata/first-frame checks, fixed native flac 1.5 stages, fresh trusted native decode verification, discovery, guidance, Studio starters and bounded native acceptance against FLAC 1.5.0.
